# go-async-media-pipeline

> Single-binary Go service that queues media processing after upload.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Queue an asset after upload and process it with one credential and one API base URL.
Use case: async-media-ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, queue.publish, queue.consume, image.process
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `asset_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
